__citations__.text:
PARTIES
1.1 This Agreement is made between Calder Freight Systems Ltd
(the "Carrier") and the Shipper identified in Schedule A.

Payment is due
within forty-five (45) days of invoice date.

TERMINATION
3.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience
by giving not less than sixty (60) days’ written notice.

3.2 On expiry of the initial term this Agreement shall renew
automatically for successive twelve-month periods unless
terminated under clause 3.1.
